description: This file contains functions for generating a grid structure for a matrix visualization, including title generation with Handlebars templates, label extraction, filter creation, cell form data generation, and overall grid assembly based on configuration.

methods.name: generateCellTitle
methods.description: Generates a cell title from a template using Handlebars, with fallback on errors.

methods.name: getAxisLabel
methods.description: Extracts label from a metric or dimension value based on axis configuration.

methods.name: createDimensionFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter object for a specific dimension value.

methods.name: generateCellFormData
methods.description: Creates form data for a specific grid cell, including filters and metrics based on row/column configuration.

methods.name: generateMatrixifyGrid
methods.description: Generates a complete grid structure from the provided form data and configuration.
